medicāmentum, medicāmentī n.

noun, second declension

medicine, a drug, a remedy

Other words

  • medicāmen, medicāminis n. — medicine, a drug, a remedy

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Traupman 63, 166; M-O s.v. drug, medicine; Traupman 307

  • medicāmentum psychotropium — a narcotic, a psychoactive drug

    also used · modern · Traupman 349

Examples

  • Medicāmentum amārum est, sed prōderit.

    The medicine is bitter, but it’ll do you good.composed

See also take, pill, painkiller, cough syrup, prescription, remedy.
